verdicts.issue: AFTER simile is one long sentence with a dangling 'then go' after 'with their jaws red with blood' and the clause 'and know no fear because hunger drives them', so the sequence (feast, red jaws, go to drink, reek of blood, fearless from hunger) is hard to follow.
verdicts.fix: Meanwhile Achilles went everywhere among the tents and told his Myrmidons to put on their armor. As fierce, ravening wolves feast on a horned stag they have killed in the mountains, their jaws red with blood, and then go in a pack to lap water from a clear spring with their long thin tongues, reeking of blood and slaughter and knowing no fear because hunger drives them, so the leaders and counselors of the Myrmidons gathered around the good squire of the swift descendant of Aeacus, and Achilles himself stood among them, urging on both men and horses.
